card.name: Verb 'have' before sex or intercourse
card.fires_on: The verb have, has or having (and sometimes 'unprotected') right before an expected word like sex or intercourse. It appears in fertility, contraception and sexual health text.

modes.label: Have sex / intercourse
modes.description: A form of 'have' used as the verb of sexual activity, just before 'sex' or 'intercourse'.
modes.example: The patient should be instructed to use a back-up method of birth control if she<< has>> sex in the seven (7) days

modes.label: Advice on timing intercourse
modes.description: Instructions to have intercourse at set times to conceive.
modes.example: The woman and her partner should be encouraged to<< have>> intercourse daily, beginning on the day prior

card.writes: It pushes the model to say the word sex or sexual next.
card.plain: It fires on 'have' when the next word is likely to be sex or intercourse.
